expected_diagnosis: Client private key permissions are too open.
recommended_next_checks: Inspect which key is being offered; check permissions.
resolution_guidance: On own lab client, chmod 600 ~/.ssh/lab_key; retry.
verification: ssh -i key succeeds without exposing private key.
escalate_when: Still denied after client key check.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
